_format.name: _format
_format.description: Response format type. The HTTP `Accept` header is used as the format if this parameter is unspecified. If the `Accept` header is unspecifed too then `JSON` is used. Keys of elements that do not start with a letter or an underline are prefixed with an underline for `XML`. Fields of a list type are skipped for `CSV`.

_with.name: _with
_with.description: List of response object fields separated by comma. An object must contain at least one of these fields to be returned. Also a response contains only these fields.

_filter.name: filter
_filter.description: List of response object fields with their values. A response contains the objects matched to the filter. The filter is passed as URL query parameters. Nested fields are joined by dot, see the example.

_keepDefault.name: _keepDefault
_keepDefault.description: If this parameter is `false` or unspecified (default behavior) then default fields of response result objects are skipped. If this parameter is specified and is empty or `true` then they are not skipped.

_local.name: _local
_local.description: If this parameter is `false` or unspecified (default behavior) then the handler is allowed to gather information from the other servers. If this parameter is specified and is empty or `true` then the Server will not collect from other servers.

_strict.name: _strict
_strict.description: If this parameter is `false` or unspecified (default behavior) then the handler will produce available results skipping the minor errors. If this parameter is specified and is empty or `true` then the Server will fail on any error.

licenseBlock.description:
License Block - a plain-text "property" file (with "key=value" lines). It is generated by the License Server, is bound to the particular Server (via Hardware Id), and is signed (the signature is stored in one of the properties). The License Block contains the following properties (keys):
  • NAME VMS product name.
  • SERIAL Serial number of the License.
  • HWID Hardware Id of the Server to which the License is bound.
  • COUNT Number of cameras which are covered by the License.
  • CLASS Type of the License. Defines which VMS platforms can use the License, and for what kind of camera-like devices.
  • VERSION VMS version.
  • BRAND VMS product name.
  • EXPIRATION Expiration date in format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Optional; if omitted, the License lifetime is unlimited.
  • SIGNATURE2 Digital signature created by the License Server.
  • COMPANY VMS vendor.
Additionally, other proprietary keys may appear in the License Block.
